task.name: Play music on YouTube
task.description: Open YouTube in Chrome, search for music, select a relevant music video, and start playback.

execution.success_condition: Chrome window is open and ready for interaction
execution.recovery: If Chrome is already open, continue with the existing Chrome window.

execution.success_condition: YouTube interface is visible and interactive
Search box and YouTube controls are identifiable
The text 'music' appears in the search box
YouTube search results for music are displayed
At least one relevant music result is identifiable
The selected YouTube video page is open
The current playback state and Play button are identifiable

verification.success_condition: A YouTube music video is actively playing.
verification_actions: confirm the player is in a playing state
confirm the playback progress is advancing
verification.failure_action: Identify the failed step, attempt an appropriate recovery, and retry the failed action. If playback cannot be started after recovery, report the task as failed.
